_note: Add paying Featured Partners here. The directory generator reads this file and injects cards into the Featured Partners section. Each entry requires: name, url, description (2-3 sentences, Tulsa Gays voice), tier (community|partner|pride), monthly_fee, active (true/false). Address is optional.
_highlight_note: AUTO-HIGHLIGHT (William 2026-07-20): eotw_selector.py auto-promotes an active partner's SPECIAL event to an Event-of-the-Week hero each week it happens - no manual_eotw.json entry needed. Opt a partner in with active:true (default) and out with highlight:false. `match` is a list of lowercase substrings tested against each event's name + source + venue; omit it to default to the partner name. Routine support meetings / services are always excluded (support-meeting policy).
